title: Question 25
passage:
Sam says he can play if the court dries. Should I tell everyone we’re starting at six?
A. Ask him to bring the ball when he comes. B. Let everyone know six is possible, but wait to confirm until you’ve checked the court. C. Tell them we’ll start at six even if two people get there late.
passageZh:
Sam 說球場乾了他就能打。我要跟大家說六點開始嗎？
A. 請他來的時候帶球。 B. 跟大家說有可能六點開始，但要先去看看球場再確認。 C. 跟大家說，就算有兩個人晚到，我們還是六點開始。
